title: Reports page crashed (blank page, TypeError 'Cannot read properties of null (reading report)') when a report was clicked in the list while none was selected
root_cause: useApi keeps the previous state until its effect runs; with the new ?id the first render had data=null and loading=false, and the page dereferenced data.report
fix: render the loading state whenever data is not yet available
evidence: UI-E-010b (browser regression test); first crawl logged the pageerror

title: 'Evaluate' started unlimited concurrent GPU evaluations; four clicks produced four failed jobs (CUDA out of memory, 'paging file is too small', array allocation failure) and the UI gave no feedback
root_cause: POST /api/models/{id}/evaluate spawned a subprocess per call with no check for running jobs on a 4 GB GPU; the Models page showed nothing on success
fix: 409 job_already_running while any job is running/queued (ConflictError); UI shows 'Evaluation started ... one job runs at a time'
evidence: jobs job-89b879436e, job-82c79d0718, job-74efa27ace, job-f27703cc07 (failed); unit test

title: Models page 'Use' for the numbering checkpoint returned HTTP 422
root_cause: ModelSelectRequest.task Literal lacked 'numbering' although the registry supports it
fix: added 'numbering'

title: GET /api/analyses/{id}/overlay returned 404 'no detections' for every full-pipeline analysis
root_cause: overlay_png only understood the older 'detections' payload, full analyses store 'regions'
fix: draw regions with FDI number, candidate class and a review marker; no class drawn for abstained regions

title: Report validator accepted impossible evidence (probability 1.7, label 'Healthy') and flagged Deep-Caries-only reports for mentioning 'caries'
root_cause: validate_report compared report to evidence but never validated the evidence; the vocabulary scan matched 'caries' inside 'Deep Caries'
fix: range and category checks (spelling-insensitive), vocabulary scan removes the evidence's own labels first
evidence: RPT-E05/E06, live check of the Deep Caries report

title: POST /api/reviews accepted an image-level review for an image id that does not exist and stored an orphan row
root_cause: image existence was only checked for region-level actions
fix: route validates the image id (404)

title: A checkpoint whose bytes did not match the sha256 in its sidecar was still registered as dental-trained
root_cause: registry validated sidecar fields only; the recorded checkpoint_sha256 was never compared with the file
fix: cached sha256 comparison during the scan; mismatch -> rejected with a reason

title: Job errors and log tails exposed raw tracebacks and absolute local paths through GET /api/training/jobs
root_cause: stderr tails were stored and served verbatim
fix: short_error serves the final exception line; strip_paths reduces absolute paths (including paths with spaces) to file names; raw text stays in the DB

title: /api/health with service probes took 6.5-8 s when TensorBoard/Label Studio were not running
root_cause: 'localhost' tried over IPv6 first on Windows; the two probes ran one after the other
fix: probe 127.0.0.1 and run both probes concurrently (about 2 s)

title: Wrong HTTP status codes: unknown job id -> 400 (should be 404); explaining a too-small region -> 503 (should be 422)
root_cause: generic DentaMindError / ModelUnavailableError used
fix: NotFoundError and ImageValidationError

title: Upload-limit message said 'the limit is 26 MB' for a 25 MiB limit
root_cause: bytes divided by 1e6 for the limit and the file size
fix: MiB arithmetic

title: Active-learning rounds did not record which model produced the uncertainty signals (model_version null)
root_cause: model_version only taken from the request body
fix: store the model(s) behind the selected images' signals; random draws record none
evidence: rounds created before the fix show null

title: Controls that silently did nothing or were disabled without explanation: Active Learning steps 5/6 before a selection, Back on step 1, Annotations Pull / Approve / Reject
root_cause: click handlers ignored the click; no title on disabled buttons
fix: disabled with an explanatory title

title: Recorded dataset provenance (splits_sha) changed whenever the dataset was re-processed, even though no image moved
root_cause: sha256 of the whole splits file, which contains an 'updated' timestamp
fix: added assignments_sha (canonical hash of image id -> split); the historical sidecars carry the old file hashes and cannot be re-verified byte-for-byte
evidence: dataset_version of the AL reproduction differs from the original in manifest_sha/splits_sha only; split sizes and the 65-radiograph/331-crop validation set are identical

title: run_al_experiment.py and evaluate_model.py could only overwrite Data/reports; AL runs stored no selection manifests, so selections were not reproducible or auditable
root_cause: fixed output folder, metrics-only records
fix: --out-dir, --device, --no-db; per-round labeled_sha and selected_next manifest; evaluation reproduction skips the numbering registration write-back

title: /api/health returns version 'unknown' (also printed by check_running.ps1)
root_cause: version comes from installed package metadata; the project is run from source
fix: backend/version.py APP_VERSION = '0.2.0' (same as FastAPI and frontend/package.json) used by main.py and /api/health
evidence: API-002 PASS; SEC2-03; check_running.ps1 prints version=0.2.0

title: Stopping the supervisor of start_backend.ps1 (--reload) on Windows leaves an orphan worker holding the port
root_cause: uvicorn reload spawns a worker that inherits the listening socket
fix: documented: stop the process tree (taskkill /T)

title: Documentation recommends -ExecutionPolicy Bypass although local scripts run under RemoteSigned; Bypass is blocked by some managed environments
Git repository root is the whole D:\ drive and has no commits
root_cause: repository initialised at the drive root

title: Original DENTEX modules import undeclared packages (detectron2, cv2, lightning, tqdm, albumentations, skimage)
root_cause: legacy research code outside the DentaMind app

title: Segmentation mask run-length encoding is row-major ('order':'C'), not COCO column-major
root_cause: self-describing app format
fix: documented in the end-to-end report

title: Original active-learning grid and detection/segmentation/numbering metrics were not re-executed in this audit; a CPU reproduction of one AL cell differs by up to 0.09 macro-F1 from the GPU run
root_cause: cost, occupied GPU; device nondeterminism not isolated

title: Side effects of the audit's own first UI crawl (it clicked state-changing buttons before the crawler blocked POSTs)
root_cause: audit tooling
fix: effects: active_models.json created (removed afterwards), 4 failed evaluation jobs (kept as history), one real pool-scoring job (kept), dataset re-process (manifests and splits file rewritten with unchanged counts), leakage_check report regenerated with unchanged results

title: A cancelled training job still wrote a checkpoint and sidecar, so a half-trained model was registered as a verified dental model
root_cause: _save_checkpoint ran after the loop even when the job was cancelled
fix: no checkpoint is written when the job is cancelled
evidence: TAPI-12 (failed before the fix, passes after)

title: resume_checkpoint accepted any EXISTING file reachable with '..' and any registry file regardless of task or verification
root_cause: only Path.is_file() was checked
fix: must be a registered, verified checkpoint of the same task; '..' refused

title: Starting a training job did not check for another running job (GPU / experiment-name race)
root_cause: only evaluate had a guard
fix: JobManager.running_jobs(); start (and dry run) answer 409 job_already_running; dead-process jobs do not block

title: No authentication, loopback restriction or rate limiting on any route (D-security open item from the first audit)
root_cause: not implemented
fix: backend/security.py: token auth (runtime/api_token.txt or DENTAMIND_API_TOKEN, injected server-side by the Vite proxy), loopback-only, per-client rate limits, failed-auth throttle

title: Training page showed a TensorBoard link although TensorBoard is not installed and no event files exist
root_cause: static link
fix: backend reports installed/event files; UI shows the truthful state

title: Uncertainty signals were shown without any statement of how well each was validated; mask/detection instability had never been measured against ground truth
root_cause: validation measured only for entropy/flip disagreement
fix: scripts/evaluate_instability.py (val split): AUROC 0.59 (mask, very weak) and 0.64 (detection, weak) are measured and displayed next to each signal; API record carries signal_validation

title: Hindi/Marathi 'not reviewed' status was only small print at the bottom of reports
root_cause: note placed in the footer
fix: prominent bilingual 'awaiting linguistic review' line at the top of HTML, TXT and the on-screen report, plus a machine-readable linguistic_review field

title: Training prerequisites route rejected task 'numbering'
root_cause: regex allow-list
fix: added
